record.kind: mask-form switch on shield depletion (OnShieldDepletedEffect) plus a passive-keyed branch inside the IVY_CUDGEL ability
record.summary: Passive.OGERPON_WELLSPRING has one PassiveEffects entry, an OnShieldDepletedEffect created by ogerponMaskDropEffect; the rest of its behaviour is a passive-keyed branch of the IVY_CUDGEL ability (the Passive is also referenced in the ability file and the item-drop code). Units OGERPON_WELLSPRING and OGERPON_WELLSPRING_MASK are both 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 1, GRASS + AQUATIC, same stats; the MASK form holds the WELLSPRING_MASK item (declared SHIELD 100 and SPE_DEF 10). When the masked unit's shield is depleted the entity is renamed to OGERPON_WELLSPRING and the mask item is removed from the entity. On every IVY_CUDGEL cast (both forms) the target takes the ability hit (100 at 3 stars, requested special damage); then each ally in the adjacent cells (centre excluded, so not the caster) receives addPP(25, caster, apBoost 1, crit) followed by handleHeal(50, caster, apBoost 1, crit). Both are REQUESTED amounts: the PP request is multiplied by (1 + caster AP/100) and by critPower on a crit, halved on a positive request if the ally is fatigued, rounded, and dropped entirely if the ally is silenced, has status.protect (not Rune Protect), has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting; the final pp is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1. The heal request goes through handleHeal: a wounded ally gets 0 (plus only a Blood Stone shield request under Blood Moon); otherwise an ally with hp > 0 and no status.protect gets 50 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower, then x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burning, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at the ally's missing HP; a GRASS-synergy ally converts overheal into addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) (current HP rises too; Big Eater Belt applies to that downstream call). Each ally is processed in cell order, PP first then heal; neither call checks the other. No gameplay claims.
triggers: OnShieldDepletedEffect: the shield reaches 0 after a hit or a negative addShield
IVY_CUDGEL cast: branch keyed on pokemon.passive

effects.declaredRaw: WELLSPRING_MASK declares SHIELD 100 and SPE_DEF 10; when the shield is depleted the MASK form reverts to OGERPON_WELLSPRING
effects.scaling: none; shield requested = 100 via addShield(100, self, 0, false); SPE_DEF requested = 10 via addSpecialDefense(10, self, 0, false)
effects.resolution: requested shield 100; applied by addShield: enraged halves a positive shield, Math.round. SPE_DEF 10 goes through addSpecialDefense (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers, then speDef = max(0, speDef + value); section I of core-mechanics.md). On depletion the effect sets entity name/index to OGERPON_WELLSPRING and removes the mask item from the entity; the bonuses already applied (including +10 SPE_DEF) are not reversed in the code read

effects.declaredRaw: IVY_CUDGEL hit on the target: 100 at 3 stars (table 50 / 75 / 100 / 200)
effects.scaling: handleSpecialDamage default apBoost; crit flag from the cast
effects.resolution: requested 100 (3 stars); blocked on a protected / skydiving / magic-bouncing target; otherwise reduced by SPE_DEF with the min-1 rule

effects.scaling: addPP(25, caster, apBoost 1, crit): requested 25 x (1 + caster AP / 100) x (critPower if crit) x (0.5 if the ally is fatigued), Math.round
effects.resolution: requested 25. Applied change: the rounded value (Twist Band can only flip a negative value, not relevant to a positive request; Big Eater Belt is not applied by addPP), dropped if the ally is silenced, has status.protect (Protect, NOT Rune Protect), has the NO_PP_GAIN effect or is resurrecting; otherwise pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1). Allies only; the caster is not in the adjacent set (centre excluded). See core-mechanics.md J3

effects.declaredRaw: 50 HP healed on each adjacent ally
effects.scaling: handleHeal(50, caster, apBoost 1, crit): requested 50 x (1 + caster AP / 100) x (critPower if crit), then recipient modifiers
effects.resolution: requested 50. Order (core-mechanics.md J2): wound branch first (wounded ally: healReceived 0 / overheal 0; under Blood Moon with a Blood Stone held by its player an addShield(round(0.3 x stones x raw heal)) request is made, recipient as caster); otherwise needs hp > 0 and no status.protect (Rune Protect is not read); modifiers x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH; Math.round; healReceived = min(missing HP, heal); overheal = heal - missing HP; GRASS-synergy recipient: addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) (not 40 percent of max HP; Big Eater Belt applies to that call; current HP rises with it, no healDone). The returned values are not used by the ability

conditions: Mask-drop switch only when the current name is the MASK form and the mask item is held.
The IVY_CUDGEL branch is keyed on pokemon.passive, so both forms behave alike.
Adjacent cells exclude the centre; only same-team occupants receive PP and heal; there is no HP-threshold or lowest-HP targeting in the branch.
record.resetBehaviour: The mask-drop switch happens once (the mask item is removed). The PP and heal branch runs on every IVY_CUDGEL cast; PP gains are not added to the caster; fight-only state.

evidence.note: OnShieldDepletedEffect (origin = the mask item): when the unit's name is the MASK form and it holds the mask, its entity name/index are switched to the unmasked form and the mask item is removed from the entity
called when a hit's shield part is >= the remaining shield
also called when a negative addShield brings the shield to 0 or below
applied after taking a hit that removed all the remaining shield
OnItemDroppedEffect: dropping a mask item on an Ogerpon swaps any current mask, adds the new mask and transforms into the matching MASK form (refused if 3 items are held and no mask to replace)
declared item SHIELD stat becomes addShield(value, self, 0, false) when the entity is created (see core-mechanics.md section I)
addShield: no AP scaling at apBoost 0, crit factor only if crit, enraged halves positive shield, then Math.round
a protected unit takes no damage (death false, takenDamage 0)
handleSpecialDamage on a protected, skydiving or magic-bouncing target is blocked (spellBlockedCount) instead of damaging
main hit on the target for every Ogerpon form (50 / 75 / 100 / 200 by stars; all four units here are 3 stars -> 100), special damage via handleSpecialDamage
getAdjacentCells(x, y, false) returns the up to 8 surrounding cells without the centre; the ability passes false for the passive branches
plain functions: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down on positive changes; Twist Band flips negative changes from enemies/environment
